A '''servo-dio''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] component. The [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[L7-BO|L7-B0]], as part of a scam with its owner, [[Sleightan]], would complain about problems with his servo-dio as an excuse to leave the company of individuals it had been sold to. Once out of his new owners presence, it would return to Sleightan.
